question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Keen
solution:
The correct answer is: **Indifferent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Keen"** means having or showing eagerness or enthusiasm. It can also refer to being highly perceptive or sharp. (उत्सुक, तीव्र)

 
 
• **Example:** She is very keen to start her new project.
 
 
 
• **"Indifferent"** refers to having no particular interest or concern; being apathetic or neutral. (उदासीन, तटस्थ)
 
 
• **Example:** He seemed indifferent to the outcome of the match.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **'keen'** is **'indifferent'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Indifferent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Understanding** (समझ): The ability to comprehend or sympathize with someone’s situation or feelings.

 
 
• **Example:** She is very understanding and always listens to others’ problems.
 
 
 
• **Acceptable** (स्वीकार्य): Something that is satisfactory or agreeable.
 
 
• **Example:** The proposal was acceptable to everyone in the team.
 
 
 
• **Tolerant** (सहिष्णु): Showing willingness to accept or endure opinions or behaviors different from one’s own.
 
 
• **Example:** A tolerant society embraces diversity and inclusiveness.
